Fornicatores et adulteros iudicabit Deus: For fornicators and adulterers God will judge
contented with such things as you have
ita ut confidenter dicamus: So that we may confidently say
I will not fear what man shall do to me
locuti sunt verbum Dei, quorum intuentes: who have spoken the word of God to you; whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation
Christus Iesus heri et hodie, ipse et in: Jesus Christ, yesterday, and today; and the same for ever
Doctrinis variis: Be not led away with various
Optimum enim est gratia stabiliri cor,: For it is best that the heart be established with grace
non escis que non profuerunt: not with meats; which have not profited
Quorum enim animalium: For the bodies of those beasts
et Iesus ut sanctificaret per suum sangu: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people by his own blood, suffered without the gate
but we seek one that is to come
Per ipsum ergo offeramus: By him therefore let us offer
hostiam laudis semper Deo,: the sacrifice of praise always to God
Beneficientie autem: And do not forget to do good
for by such sacrifices God's favour is obtained
quasi rationem pro animabus vestris redd: as being to render an account of your souls
bene volentes: being willing to behave ourselves well
Amplius autem deprecor vos: And I beseech you the more
that I may be restored to you the sooner
Deus autem pacis: And may the God of peace
pastorem magnum ovium,: the great pastor of the sheep
quod placeat coram se: that which is well pleasing in his sight
glory for ever and ever. Amen.
Rogo autem vos, fratres, ut sufferatis: And I beseech you, brethren, that you suffer
Cognoscite fratrem nostrum Timotheum: Know ye that our brother Timothy
with whom (if he come shortly) I will see you
Salutant vos de Italia fratres: The brethren from Italy salute you
